🌟 Obtainium | Dart
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a decentralized and user-controlled method for obtaining and updating Android applications directly from their developers' release channels, bypassing traditional app stores.
✨ Key Features: • Install and update apps directly from source release pages • Supports GitHub, GitLab, F-Droid, and many other app stores/sources • Notifications for new app releases
📖 Summary: Obtainium is an Android application that allows users to install and update applications directly from their source release pages, such as GitHub or GitLab. It provides notifications for new releases and supports a wide variety of app sources, including F-Droid, APKMirror, and direct APK links.
